about: Albayan Studio display stages (PLAN.md §5.4, task P1-20). Shared by the server (server/systems/ads_studio/studio_results.py, tested in server/test_studio_results.py) and the client fallback (P2-01). 'tables' must equal studio_results.stage_tables(); every case's 'expect' lists the fields derive_display_stage(request, results, now) must return.

4.en: Approved — being set up in Meta

6.en: Meta rejected the ad — the team is fixing it

7.en: Delivery problem — the team is fixing it

reserve_released.en: The reserved amount is back in your balance

paid_meta_rejected.en: Paid — usually nothing was used; if it cannot be fixed in time, the full amount comes back
paid_meta_rejected.ar: مدفوع — عادةً لم يُصرف شيء، وإن تعذّر إصلاحه في الوقت المحدد نعيد المبلغ كاملاً

paid_running.en: Paid — Meta reports what it used so far
paid_running.ar: مدفوع — تعرض ميتا ما استخدمته حتى الآن

paid_settling.en: Unused money comes back after Meta's final numbers, usually within 2–3 days
paid_settling.ar: نحسب المبلغ النهائي بعد أن تثبت أرقام ميتا — عادةً خلال يومين إلى ثلاثة

full_return.en: Meta never showed your ad — we return the full amount within one working day
full_return.ar: لم تعرض ميتا إعلانك — نعيد المبلغ كاملاً خلال يوم عمل

final.en: Final — what Meta used is spent, the rest came back
final.ar: نهائي — صُرف ما استخدمته ميتا وعاد الباقي

returned.en: The unused amount came back to your wallet
returned.ar: عاد المبلغ غير المصروف إلى محفظتك

never_linked.en: This ad was never created in Meta
never_linked.ar: لم يُنشأ هذا الإعلان في ميتا

runningPastEnd.en: Running past the promised end — the team is on it
runningPastEnd.ar: ما زال يعمل بعد موعد الانتهاء — الفريق يتابعه

stopRequested.en: Stop requested — we will pause it soon

stale.en: Meta has not been checked for a while
stale.ar: لم نتحقق من ميتا منذ مدة

cases.name: approved_unlinked_starts_today
cases.note: the start day itself still allows the customer's own full-refund stop

cases.name: approved_marked_live_after_end
cases.note: a legacy ad staff marked live by hand did run: no full-return promise

cases.name: libya_day_boundary
cases.note: 00:30 on 15 October in Tripoli: the 14th has passed there although it is still the 14th in UTC

cases.name: ended_by_stop_request
cases.note: a stop request is an end signal, so a paused ad with one is Ended, not Paused

cases.name: delivery_problem_billing
cases.note: the customer never sees 'billing' (Albayan's own account needs funds)

cases.name: mixed_disapproved_and_paused
cases.note: no rule of PLAN.md §5.4 matches: the team is still setting it up

cases.name: stop_requested_overlay_running
cases.note: the stop chip shows instead of 'running past the promised end' (dates only)

cases.name: bad_results_values_read_safely
cases.note: an unreadable check time means never checked

cases.name: meta_fed_review_wins_over_disapproved
cases.note: P3-04a: an ad still in Meta's review keeps stage 5 even when another ad was rejected

cases.name: meta_fed_active_after_meta_end_time
cases.note: Meta keeps ads ACTIVE after the ad set end_time, but nothing delivers then: Ended, never Running (and no running_past_end)

cases.name: meta_fed_active_after_campaign_stop_time
cases.note: The campaign stop_time passed: the ads still say ACTIVE but the campaign has ended on Meta

cases.name: meta_fed_sync_error_keeps_last_good_stage
cases.note: a failed sync never clears the last answered read: the stage and the numbers stay

cases.name: meta_fed_unreadable_insights_keep_spend
cases.note: P3-01: an insights read Meta did not answer keeps the last confirmed spend (never 0)
